newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet may act to boost car sector - minister.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet may act to boost car sector - minister.

text.p: The Italian cabinet may approve measures to boost the flagging Italian car industry among provisions being considered at a meeting under way on Monday, Environment Minister Edo Ronchi said.
Asked by reporters at a news conference whether provisions to help the flagging auto sector were among itemds to be approved at the cabinet meeting, Ronchi replied: "I think they will be."

He gave no further details. Prime Minister Romano Prodi's cabinet is meeting to approve a package of 4.3 trillion lire worth of measures which form the final part of Italy's 1997 62.5 trillion lire budget.

Auto sector research group CSP has said recent data show the Italian market is basically stagnant. The group has been one of the leading industry voices calling for government incentives to revive the domestic car market.
However earlier in December Prodi appeared to dash hopes of measures to help the market, saying he did not believe special financial incentives were the best way to boost car sales.
